**Backtesting • Trading Dashboards • Market Data • Strategy Analytics • Trading Workflows • Data Processing**

* Software Engineering
* Quantitative Finance
* Algorithmic Trading

* Data Engineering
* FinTech
* Backtesting Systems
* Trading Infrastructure

* OHLCV data
* Tick data
* Options data
* Instrument metadata
* Historical market data
* Real\\-time data feeds
* Data normalization
* Data validation
* Time\\-series processing

* Risk\\-management logic
* Broker/API integrations

* Strategy configuration and management

* Document technical workflows and processes.

* B.Tech / B.E. students
* M.Tech students
* Computer Science / IT students
* Mathematics / Statistics students with strong programming skills
